cases.name: page resource: an answer that is not a page is an internal error

error.message:
MCP error -32603: LogSeq answered logseq.Editor.getPage in a shape this server can't read: name: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined

Steps to fix:
1. Check which LogSeq version is running. This server is tested against LogSeq 0.10.x, and a different version may name or type fields differently
2. If the version is right, report this on the project's GitHub issues with the method name and the path above (leave out page names and block text)
